verdict: Organic traffic is declining sharply; no paid channels are active this period.
narrative: In the last 28 days, no paid spend ran on Meta or Google, leaving your Google Business Profile and organic search to carry all engagement. GBP delivered 231 total actions — 73 calls, 94 direction requests, and 64 website clicks — but GBP activity dropped 40% in the most recent week and has recorded zero actions over the last three days, confirming this is a real decline, not a fluctuation. Organic search visibility fell sharply as well, with Search Console clicks down 70.83% week-over-week and continuing flat-to-declining into September. We are investigating the source of the search visibility drop and working to get your reporting dashboard and attribution in order so the full picture is readable before your renewal decision.
